picks.headline: Watch out, Suno: Google upgrades Lyria AI music model with 'more realistic and emotionally nuanced vocals'
picks.excerpt: Google has launched Lyria 3.5, its upgraded AI music-generation model, inside Google Flow Music. DeepMind says the model brings 'significant advancements across musicality, lyrics and vocal quality', with more realistic, emotionally nuanced vocals, improved pronunciation and richer, more natural melodic structures.
picks.rationale: Major, credible AI music-model upgrade that raises the vocal-quality bar producers work against tomorrow. Highest novelty + actionability.

picks.headline: Tim Exile Previews Karst Software Modular System
picks.excerpt: Tim Exile previewed Karst, a digital modular system for making music through systems and algorithmic composition. It features a node editor, cableless patching with cloud sync, and an Event Core in every instrument that lets you hand-roll generative algorithms without wrestling event scheduling or polyphony.
picks.rationale: New generative-modular environment with a node editor and hand-rolled algorithms — a concrete craft tool that changes how sound designers build patches.

picks.headline: Tunary Intros SILT Generative Tape-Loop Instrument
picks.excerpt: Tunary Instruments has introduced SILT, a 'Generative Tape-Loop Instrument' built around four short melodic loops of different lengths that drift slowly out of phase through an emulated tape machine, generating evolving ambient patterns for producers with vintage warmth.
picks.rationale: Fresh generative instrument for evolving ambient textures — a novel, ready-to-use tool for producers chasing vintage warmth.
